about_the_game: Demo for "The Eldritch Ascent" In this game, every step forward is a battle for survival. Engage in strategic, turn-based combat against increasingly ferocious foes as you ascend the tower's levels.  Each floor brings new challenges to overcome.

content_descriptors.notes: Fantasy gothic narrative of dark themes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 10/11
  • Processor: 2+ GHz Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL ES 2.0 Hardware Driver Support
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
